segments.ja534:3.3: Mā anīghāya hāpesi, kāmaṃ sumukha pakkama”.
segments.ja534:4.1: “Nāhaṃ dukkhaparetopi [dukkhapareto”ti (jā.1.15.136) aṭṭhakathāyo oloketabbā], dhataraṭṭha tuvaṃ [tavaṃ (sī. pī.)] jahe;
segments.ja534:4.3: Jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ vā me, tayā saddhiṃ bhavissati.
segments.ja534:6.1: “Sakumāro sakhā tyasmi, sacitte casmi te [samite (pī.), tyasmi te (ka.)] ṭhito;
segments.ja534:7.3: Taṃ hitvā patataṃ seṭṭha, kiṃ te vakkhāmito gato;
segments.ja534:7.5: Idha pāṇaṃ cajissāmi, nānariyaṃ [na anariyaṃ (pī.)] kattumussahe”.
segments.ja534:8.1: “Eso hi dhammo sumukha, yaṃ tvaṃ ariyapathe ṭhito;
segments.ja534:8.3: Yo bhattāraṃ sakhāraṃ maṃ, na pariccattumussahe.
segments.ja534:9.3: Adhigacchasi tvaṃ mayhaṃ, evaṃ bhūtassa jīvitaṃ”.
segments.ja534:11.3: Aṭṭhāsi purato rañño, haṃso vissāsayaṃ byadhaṃ [byathaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja534:12.1: “Mā bhāyi patataṃ seṭṭha, na hi bhāyanti tādisā;
segments.ja534:14.1: “Na me sutaṃ vā diṭṭhaṃ vā, bhāsanto mānusiṃ dijo;
segments.ja534:14.3: Ariyaṃ bruvāno [brūhanto (syā. ka.)] vakkaṅgo, cajanto mānusiṃ giraṃ.
segments.ja534:15.1: “Kinnu tāyaṃ dijo hoti, mutto baddhaṃ upāsasi;
segments.ja534:15.3: Ohāya sakuṇā yanti, kiṃ eko avahīyasi”.
segments.ja534:17.1: “Mahāgaṇāya bhattā me, mā eko byasanaṃ agā;
segments.ja534:17.3: Tathā taṃ samma nesāda, bhattāyaṃ abhito rame”.
segments.ja534:18.3: Cajāmi te taṃ bhattāraṃ, gacchathūbho [gacchatu bho (pī.)] yathāsukhaṃ”.
segments.ja534:21.1: “Yassa tvaṃ bhatako [bhaṭako (ka.)] rañño, kāmaṃ tasseva pāpaya;
segments.ja534:22.3: Ubho hatthehi saṅgayha [paggayha (syā. ka.)], pañjare ajjhavodahi.
segments.ja534:30.1: “Māyā cesā marīcī ca, soko rogo cupaddavo;
segments.ja534:30.3: Kharā ca bandhanā cetā, maccupāsā guhāsayā [paccupāso guhāsayo (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja534:30.5: Tāsu yo vissase poso, so naresu narādhamo”.
segments.ja534:32.3: Bījāni tyāsu rūhanti, yadidaṃ sattā pajāyare;
segments.ja534:32.5: Tāsu ko nibbide [nibbije (ka.)] poso, pāṇamāsajja pāṇibhi [pāṇahi (sī.)].
segments.ja534:33.3: Tassa tyajja bhaye jāte, bhītena jāyate mati.
segments.ja534:34.1: “Sabbo hi saṃsayaṃ patto, bhayaṃ bhīru titikkhati;
segments.ja534:34.3: Paṇḍitā ca mahantāno [mahattāno (sī.)], atthe yuñjanti duyyuje.
segments.ja534:36.1: “Mā no ajja vikantiṃsu, rañño sūdā mahānase;
segments.ja534:36.3: Tathā hi vaṇṇo pattānaṃ, phalaṃ veḷuṃva taṃ vadhi.
segments.ja534:37.1: “Muttopi na icchi [nicchasi (ka.)] uḍḍetuṃ [oḍḍetuṃ (sī.)], sayaṃ bandhaṃ upāgami;
segments.ja534:37.3: Sopajja saṃsayaṃ patto, atthaṃ gaṇhāhi mā mukhaṃ”.
segments.ja534:38.1: “So taṃ [tvaṃ (syā. pī.)] yogaṃ payuñjassu, yuttaṃ dhammūpasaṃhitaṃ [dhammopasañhitaṃ (ka.)];
segments.ja534:39.1: “Mā bhāyi patataṃ seṭṭha, na hi bhāyanti tādisā;
segments.ja534:42.3: Kāmaṃ karo hiraññassa, yāvanto esa icchati”.
segments.ja534:43.3: Yadyāyaṃ [yadāyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] samma khemaka, puṇṇā haṃsehi tiṭṭhati.
segments.ja534:44.3: Okiṇṇaṃ ñātisaṅghehi, nimmajjhimaṃ [nimajjhimaṃ (sī. pī. ka.)] kathaṃ gahi”.
segments.ja534:45.1: “Ajja me sattamā ratti, adanāni [ādānāni (syā. pī. ka.)] upāsato [upāgato (ka.)];
segments.ja534:46.3: Tatthāhaṃ odahiṃ pāsaṃ, evaṃ taṃ [evetaṃ (sī. pī.)] dijamaggahiṃ”.
segments.ja534:47.1: “Ludda dve ime sakuṇā, atha ekoti bhāsasi;
segments.ja534:47.3: Cittaṃ nu te vipariyattaṃ [vipariyatthaṃ (pī.)], adu kinnu jigīsasi”[jigiṃsasi (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja534:48.3: Uraṃ saṃhacca tiṭṭhanti, so me bandhaṃ upāgami.
segments.ja534:49.3: Ariyaṃ bruvāno aṭṭhāsi, cajanto mānusiṃ giraṃ”.
segments.ja534:50.1: “Atha kiṃ [atha kinnu (sī. pī.), kathaṃ nu (syā.)] dāni sumukha, hanuṃ saṃhacca tiṭṭhasi;
segments.ja534:50.3: Adu me parisaṃ patto, bhayā bhīto na bhāsasi”.
segments.ja534:51.3: Nāhaṃ bhayā na bhāsissaṃ, vākyaṃ atthamhi tādise”.
segments.ja534:52.1: “Na te abhisaraṃ passe, na rathe napi pattike;
segments.ja534:52.3: Nāssa cammaṃ va kīṭaṃ vā, vammite ca dhanuggahe.
segments.ja534:53.1: “Na hiraññaṃ suvaṇṇaṃ vā, nagaraṃ vā sumāpitaṃ;
segments.ja534:53.5: Yattha paviṭṭho sumukha, bhāyitabbaṃ na bhāyasi”.
segments.ja534:57.3: Abhayañca tayā ghuṭṭhaṃ, imāyo dasadhā disā.
segments.ja534:58.3: Pahūtaṃ cādanaṃ tattha, ahiṃsā cettha pakkhinaṃ.
segments.ja534:59.3: Te te bandhasma pāsena, etaṃ te bhāsitaṃ musā.
segments.ja534:62.3: Tathā taṃ samma nesādo, vutto sumukha maggahi”.
segments.ja534:64.1: “Yo migena migaṃ hanti, pakkhiṃ vā pana pakkhinā;
segments.ja534:64.3: Sutena vā sutaṃ kiṇyā [kiṇe (sī. pī.)], kiṃ anariyataraṃ tato.
segments.ja534:65.3: Ubho so dhaṃsate lokā, idha ceva parattha ca.
segments.ja534:66.1: “Na majjetha yasaṃ patto, na byādhe [byathe (sī. pī.)] pattasaṃsayaṃ;
segments.ja534:67.3: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna, evaṃte [evete (sī. pī.)] tidivaṃ gatā.
segments.ja534:70.3: Yo sukhe sukhito raññe [rañño (sī. syā. pī. ka.)], dukkhite hoti dukkhito.
segments.ja534:72.3: Maṭṭhaṃ kāsikamatthannaṃ [kāsikapatthiṇṇaṃ (sī.), kāsikavatthinaṃ (syā. pī.)], dhataraṭṭho upāvisi.
segments.ja534:78.1: “Kacci bhoto amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
segments.ja534:78.3: Kacci ca te tavatthesu, nāvakaṅkhanti jīvitaṃ”.
segments.ja534:79.1: “Athopi me amaccesu, doso koci na vijjati;
segments.ja534:84.3: No ce [ca (syā. ka.)] dhammaṃ niraṃkatvā, adhammamanuvattasi”.
segments.ja534:86.1: “Kacci nānāgataṃ [kacci nunāgataṃ (syā. ka.)] dīghaṃ, samavekkhasi khattiya;
segments.ja534:86.3: Kacci matto [na matto (sī.)] madanīye, paralokaṃ na santasi”.
segments.ja534:87.3: Ṭhito dasasu dhammesu, paralokaṃ na santase [santasiṃ (syā.)].
segments.ja534:90.1: “Sumukho ca acintetvā, visajji [vissaji (sī. pī.)] pharusaṃ giraṃ;
segments.ja534:91.3: Yānasmāsu [yānasmāsu (sī. syā pī.)] na vijjanti, nayidaṃ [na idaṃ (sī. pī.)] paññavatāmiva”.
segments.ja534:92.3: Dhataraṭṭhe ca baddhasmiṃ, dukkhaṃ me vipulaṃ ahu.
segments.ja534:94.1: “Etaṃ [evaṃ (syā. ka.)] te anumodāma, yaṃ bhāvaṃ na nigūhasi;
segments.ja534:96.5: Etaṃ dadāmi vo vittaṃ, issariyaṃ [isseraṃ (sī.), issaraṃ (syā. pī. ka.)] vissajāmi vo”.
segments.ja534:97.3: Dhammesu vattamānānaṃ, tvaṃ no ācariyo bhava.
segments.ja534:98.3: Taṃ padakkhiṇato katvā, ñātiṃ [ñātī (sī. syā. pī.)] passemurindama”[passemarindama (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja534:100.1: “Tato ratyā vivasāne, sūriyuggamanaṃ [suriyassuggamanaṃ (sī. syā.), suriyuggamanaṃ (pī.)] pati;
segments.ja534:100.3: Pekkhato kāsirājassa, bhavanā te [bhavanato (syā. ka.)] vigāhisuṃ”.
